KARqavam, klI, (KARqavyAstadAKyayA prasidDAyA nagaryyA jAtam . KARqavI + aR . yaduktaM kAlikApurARe 90 aDyAye . “purA tu vijayo rAjA KARqavIM nAma tAM purIm . BaNktvA vanaM tataScakre tena tat KARqavaM vanam ..”) vanaviSezaH . tadvivaraRaM yaTA, -- “virUpasyABavadgADirgADermmitro'Bavat sutaH . tezAM kalpo'BavadrAjA kalpAttu vijayo'Bavat . yo vijitya kzitiM sarvvAM pArTivAn BUritejasA . SakrasyAnumate cakre KARqavaM Satayojanam .. yat savyasAcI hyadahat pARquputtraH pratApavAn . Avahan paramAM prItiM jvalanasya mahAtmanaH .. fzaya UcuH . kaTaM sa KARqavaM cakre vijayaH Satayojanam . tadvayaM SrotumicCAmaH kaTayasva tapoDana ! .. mArkaRqeya uvAca . somavaMSe'BavadrAjA mahAtmA sa mahAbalaH .. DIraH sudarSano nAma cArurUpaH pratApavAn . sa vE himavato nAtidUre BaNktvA mahAvanam .. siMhAn vyAGrAn samutsAryya kvaciccApi tapo- DanAn . KARqavIM nAma nagarImakarottatra SoBanAm .. triMSadyojanavistIrRAmAyatAM Satayojanam . uccaprAkArasaMyuktAM sAwwAlAmbudatoraRAm .. nimnABiratidIrGABiH pariKABiH samAvftAm . dIrGikABiScopavanErbbahuBiScApsarogaREH .. AkIrRAYca taTAvAsEruttamErapi mAnavEH . sotsavAH satataM yatra janA devAn divi sTitAn .. spardDante sma mudA yuktA AQyA BogasamanvitAH . sa vE sudarSano rAjA KAtvA BUmiM vidAryya ca .. gaNgAM kanaKalAM devIM vAhayAmAsa KARqavIm .  yezAM vAYCAsti lokAnAM madrAjyagamane punaH .. vArARasIM te gacCantu mayEva pratipAlitAm . tatastasya vacaH SrutvA janAH kecinnijaM padam .. jammu rvvArARasIM kecidbijayenABipAlitAm . tato DanAnAM tAnrASInratnAnAYca pfTak pfTak .. aSmanAM kanakAnAYca kUpyAnAM vijayastadA . DIvarErvvAhayAmAsa purIM vArARasIM prati .. ganDarvvARAYca devAnAM yadAnItaM haWAt purA . ratnadArvvAdikaM yattu vijayaM tat prasAdya ca .. tEstErnItantu KARqavyAH svasTAnaM prati harzitEH . triMSadyojanavistIrRAM SatayojanamAyatAm . tAM purIM vijayaScakre na cirAdeva vE vanam . tasmin Sakrasya sammatyA takzakaH sahito gaREH .. uvAsa suciraM tatra tato'BUnnirjjanaM vanam . tatra devAH saganDarvvAH krIqante'psarasAM gaRAH .. ASaMsayaMSca vijayaM raRezu vijayAvaham ..” * .. “azwAviMSatime prApte yuge dvAparaSezataH .. vahnirbrAhmaRarUpeRa BikzAM jizRumayAcata . dAtumaNgIkfte BikzAM tadA pARqusutena vE .. vahniH svarUpamAsTAya jizRuM vacanamabravIt . ahamagniH pARquputtra ! yajYaBAgAtiBojanAt .. vyADito'haM tato vyADiM mama tvaM nASayADunA . KARqavaM nAma vipinaM sapakzimfgarAkzasam .. yadi tvaM mAM BojayituM Saknozi SvetavAhana ! . tadA mamAtyasO vyADirapayAsyati nocirAt .. purA tu vijayo rAjA KARqavIM nAma tAM purIm . BaNktrA vanaM tataScakre tena tat KARqavaM vanam .. tadarTaM devavihitaM vanaM tacCvetavAhana ! . viroDAttatu Sakrasya na svayaM Boktumutsahe .. tanmAM trAhi mahABAga ! vane tasminniyojaya . yaTA'haM sakalaM BoktuM prApnomi tvatprasAdataH .. tasya tadbacanaM SrutvA savyasAcI mahAbalaH . dAhayAmAsa vipinaM tat sarvvaM prARisaMyutam . devakItanayenAsO vAsudevena pAlitaH . KARqavaM dAhayAmAsa jvalanasya hite rataH ..” “suprItaH pradadO tasmAdarjjunAya mahAtmane . vahrirDanuSca gARqIvaM vAruRaM devanirmmitam .. akzayAvizuDI dvO ca rUpyABAMScaturo hayAn . hanUmatADizWitantu mahAntaM vAnaraDvajam .. KaqgaYca triSiKaM tIkzRaM dahanaH savyasAcine . nIrogaScABavadvahnistadA jizRuprasAdataH .. tErvvAREstena DanuzA tena Kaqgena ketunA . tadaSvasyandanenApi vijigye PAlguno raRe .. evaM BEravavargezu saMjAto vijayo nfpaH . KARqavaM nAma vipinaM cakAra sumahAkftI ..” iti SrIkAlikApurARe 90 aDyAyaH .. (KaRqasya ikzuKaRqAdervikAra ityaR . guqAdi- vikAramizwAnnadravyam . yaTA, mahABArate . 13 . 53 . 18 . “rasAnApUpakAMScitrAn modakAnaTa KARqavAn ..”)

caturaNgam, klI, (catvAri aNgAni yasya .) hastyaSva- raTapadAtirUpaM sEnyam . yaTA, rAmAyaRe . “caturaNgaM hyapi balaM sumahat prasahemahi .” akzakrIqAviSezaH . cOraMKelA iti BAzA .. yaTA, -- yuDizWira uvAca . “azwakozWyAYca yA krIqA tAM me brUhi tapoDana ! . prakarzeREva me nATa catUrAjI yato Bavet .. vyAsa uvAca . azwo kozWAn samAliKya pradakziRakrameRa tu . aruRaM pUrbbataH kftvA dakziRe haritaM balam .. pArTa ! paScimataH pItamuttare SyAmalaM balam . rAjYo vAme gajaM kuryyAt tasmAdaSvaM tatastarim .. kuryyAt kOnteya ! purato yudDe patticatuzwayam . koRe nOkA dvitIye'SvastftIye tu gajo vaset .. turIye ca vasedrAjA vawikAH purataH sTitAH .. paYcakena vawI rAjA catuzkeREva kuYjaraH .. trikeRa tu calatyaSvaH pArTa ! nOkAdvayena tu .. kozWamekaM vilaNGyATa sarvvato yAti BUpatiH .  nOkEkA vawikA yasya vidyate Kelane yadi . gAQAvawIti viKyAtA padaM tasya na duzyati .. gAQAGAtyApadaM rAjapadaM koRapadaYca tat . haste raNge balaM nAsti kAkakAzWaM tadA Bavet .. vadanti rAkzasAH sarvve tasya na sto jayAjayO . prArTite paYcame rAjYi mftavawyAYca zawpade .. aSOcaM syAttadA rAjan ! calitvA cAlitaM padam . dbirAvfttyA gatO tasmAdDanyAt parabalaM jayI .. siMhAsanaM Bavatyeva kAkakAzWaM na BaRyate .. upavizwaYca yat sTAnaM tasyoparicatuzwaye . nOkAcatuzwayaM yatra kriyate yasya nOkayA .. nOkAcatuzwayaM tatra bfhannOketi BaRyate . na kuryyAdekadA rAjan ! gajasyABimuKaM gajam .. yadi kurvvIta DarmmajYa ! pApagrasto Bavizyati . sTAnABAve yadA pArTa ! hastinaM hastisammuKam .. karizyati tadA rAjanniti gotamaBAzitam . prApte gajadvaye rAjan ! hantavyo vAmato gajaH ..” iti tiTyAditattve caturaNgakrIqanam ..
caturaNgA, strI, (catvAri aNgAni yasyAH .) GowikAvfkzaH . iti rAjanirGaRwaH ..

caturUzaRam, klI, (caturRAM UzaRAnAM samAhAraH .) pippalImUlasahitaM trikawu . yaTA, BAvaprakASe . “tryuzaRaM sakaRAmUlaM kaTitaM caturUzaRam . vyozasyEva guRAH proktA aDikAScaturUzaRe ..”

caturgatiH, puM, (caturBirgatirasya .) kacCapaH . iti hemacandraH . 4 . 419 .. (caturRAM ASra- mARAM varRAnAM brAhmaRAdInAM yaToktakAriRAM gatirASrayaH . vizRuH . yaTA, mahABArate . 13 . 149 . 95 . “caturmUrttiScaturbbAhuScaturvyUhaScaturgatiH ..”)

caturTikA, strI, palaparimARam . iti vEdyaka- pariBAzA ..

caturTI, strI, (caturRAM pUraRI . “tasya pUraRe qaw .” 5 . 2 . 48 . iti qaw . tataH “zaw katipayacaturAM Tuk .” 5 . 2 . 41 . iti Tuk . tatazwittvAt NIp .) tiTiviSezaH . sA tu candrasya caturTakalAkriyArUpA . iti smftiH .. (caturTI tu paYcamIyutA grAhyA . “yugmAgni- kftaBUtAni .” iti yugmavacanAt taTA, -- “ekAdaSyazwamI zazWI amAvAsyA caturTikA . upozyAH parasaMyuktAH parAH pUrbbeRa saMyutAH ..” ityagnipurARavacanAcca .. Bavizye, -- “amA vE somavAreRa ravivAreRa saptamI . caturTI BOmavAreRa akzayAdapi cAkzayA ..’ yattu, -- ‘caturTIsaMyutA kAryyA tftIyA ca caturTikA . tftIyayA yutA nEva paYcamyA kArayet kvacit ..’ iti brahmavEvarttavacanaM paYcamIyutAnizeDakaM tad- vinAyakavrataparamiti gurucaraRAH tftIyAyutA nizeDakatve kvacidityanupapatteH sarvvatrEva paYcamI- yutAyA grahaRAt . sArasvatyAdipradozamAha . ‘trayodaSyAScaturTyASca saptamyA dbAdaSItiTeH . pradoze'DyayanaM DImAn na kurvvIta yaTAkramam . sArasvato gARapataH sOraSca vEzRavastaTA ..’ pradozaSabdo'tra praTamaprahara iti hemAdriH .  rAtripara iti nirRayAmftakfd BojadevaH .. ‘Suklapakze caturTyAntu siMhe candrasya darSanam . miTyABiSApaM kurute na paSyettatra taM tataH ..’ caturTyAM darSananizeDAt tatroditasya candrasya paYcamyAM darSane tu na dozaH . ataH, -- ‘paYcAnanagate BAnO pakzayoruBayorapi . caturTyAmuditaScandro nekzitavyaH kadAcana ..’ dEvAt pramAdAdvA darSane tu . “siMhaH prasenamavaDIt siMho jAmbavatA hataH . sukumAraka ! mA rodIstava hyeza syamantakaH ..” anena mantreRABimantritaM jalaM peyaM AcArAt syamantakopAKyAnaYca Srotavyam . mAGamAsasya SuklacaturTyAM gOrI pUjanIyA . yaTA, Bavizyo- ttare mAGaSuklapakzamaDikftya, -- “caturTI varadA nAma tasyAM gOrI supUjitA . sOBAgyamatalaM kuryyAtpaYcamyAM SrIrapi Sriyam ..” iti tiTyAditattvam ..) tatra jAtasya PalaM yaTA, kozWIpradIpe . “svaputtramitrapramadApramodI GftABilAzI kfpayA sametaH . vivAdaSIlo vijayI vivAde BaveccaturTIpraBavaH kaWoraH ..”

caturddantaH, pu, (catvAro dantA yasya .) ErAvata- hastI . iti hemacandraH . 2 . 91 .. (svanAma- KyAtaH paYcatantroktagajaviSezaH . yaTA, paYca- tantre . 3 . 80 . “kasmiMScidvanoddeSe caturddanto nAma mahAgajo yUTADipaH prativasati sma ..”)

(“sA ca SuklA pUrRimAyutA grAhyA yugmAt kfzRA pUrbbayutA . “kfzRapakze'zwamI cEva kfzRapakze caturddaSI . pUrbbavidDEva karttavyA paravidDA na kutracit . upavAsAdikAryyezu eza DarmmaH sanAtanaH ..” iti nigamavacanAt aparAhRavyApitve tu Sukla- caturddaSyapi pUrbbavidDA grAhyA ‘caturddaSI tu karttavyA trayodaSyA yutA viBo ! . mama BaktErmahAbAho ! BavedyA cAparAhRikI .  darSavidDA na karttavyA rAkAvidDA taTA mune ..’ iti skandapurARAt mama BaktEriti ISvarokteH Sivavratavizayam . trayodaSyAM divAtanamuhUrtta- caturddaSyalABe tu padmapurARam . ‘ekAdaSyazwamI zazWI uBe pakze caturddaSI . amAvAsyA tftIyA ca upozyAH syuH parA- nvitAH ..’ etadvizaya eva . ‘SivA GorA taTA pretAsAvitrI ca caturddaSI . kuhUyuktEva karttavyA kuhvAmeva hi pAraRam ..’ iti vacanam .” iti ca tiTyAditattvam ..) tatra jAtasya PalaM yaTA, kozWIpradIpe . “virudDaSIlaH puruzaH saroza- ScOraH kaWoraH paravaYcakaSca . parAnnaBoktA paradAracitta- ScaturddaSI cet jananasya kAle ..” mAsaviSeze tatra karmmARi yaTA . jyEzWakfzRa- caturddaSyAM strIkarttfkasAvitryAdidevatApUjA svAmipUjA ca .. caturddolam, klI, puM, (caturBirvAhakErdolyate utkzipya nIyate uhyate iti yAvat . doli + karmmaRi GaY . yadvA, caturBidaRqErupalakzitaM dolaM dolAyamAnayAnaviSezaH .) svanAmaKyAtayAna- viSezaH . yaTA, -- “rAjYo yaddvipadaM yAnaM viSezAKyamalaM viduH . caturBiruhyate yattu caturddolaM taducyate .. Bojastu . caturBirvAhakErddaRqEH zaqBiH kumBEH susaMsTitEH . stamBErazwABiruditaM caturddolamanuttamam .. tadBedA jayakalyARavIrasiMhA yaTAkramam . caturvviDAnAM BUpAnAM caturddolAH prakASitAH .. trihastasammitAyAmo dvihastapariRAhavAn . hastadvayonnataH proktaScaturddolo jayAKyayA .. caturhastAyato yastu sArdDadDandvastadanyaTA . caturddolaH samAKyAtaH kalyARastAvadunnataH .. paYcahastAyato yastu trihastapariRAhavAn . tAvadevonnato vIraScaturddola udAhftaH .. AdyaH samaravarzAsu paraH keliGanAtyaye .. sarvvezAmeva kAzWAnAM daRqaH syAdvajravAraRaH . candanenEva GawanA sarvvezAmupayujyate ..

caturmmuKaH, puM, (catvAri muKAni asya . yadvA catvAro vedAScatvAri muKAnIvAsya .) brahmA . iti SabdaratnAvalI .. (yaTA, raDuH . 10 . 22 . “caturvvargaPalaM jYAnaM kAlAvasTAScaturyugAH . caturvarRamayo lokastvattaH sarvvaM caturmmuKAt ..” “sarvvaM caturmmuKAt caturmmuKarUpiRastvattaH jAta- miti SezaH .” iti tawwIkAyAM mallinATaH .. paYcagavyam, klI, (gorvikAraH gavyam . paYcaguRitaM gavyam .) gosambanDipaYcaprakAradravyam . (yaTA, manuH . 11 . 165 . “BakzyaBojyApaharaRe yAnaSayyAsanasya ca . puzpamUlaPalAnAYca paYcagavyaM viSoDanam ..”)  tattu gomayagomUtradugDadaDiGftarUpam . yaTA, -- “paYcagavyaM daDikzIraGftagomUtragomayEH .” iti SabdacandrikA .. * .. tatparimARaM yaTA, -- “palamAtraM dugDaBAgaM gomUtraM tAvadizyate . GftaYca palamAtraM syAt gomayaM tolakatrayam .. daDi prasftamAtraM syAt paYcagavyamidaM smftam . aTavA paYcagavyAnAM samAno BAga izyate ..” iti gOtamIyatantram .. * .. api ca . “goSakfddviguRaM mUtraM payaH syAttaccaturguRam . GftaM taddviguRaM proktaM paYcagavyaM taTA daDi ..” * .. tasya pAnaPalaM yaTA, -- “paYcagavyena pUtantu vAjimeDaPalaM laBet . gavyantu paramaM meDyaM gavyAdanyanna vidyate .. sOmye muhUrtte saMyukte paYcagavyantu yaH pibet . yAvajjIvakftAt pApAt tatkzaRAdeva mucyate ..” gavyAnAM devaprItikaratvaM yaTA, -- “daDnA hi tridaSAH sarvve kzIreRa ca maheSvaraH . Gftena pAvako nityaM pAyasena pitAmahaH .. sakfddattena prIyante varzARAYca trayodaSa . tAM dattvA cEva pItvA ca preto meDyastu jAyate ..” iti varAhapurARam .. * .. tasya viSezo yaTA, -- “payaH kAYcanavarRAyAH SbetavarRotTagomayam . gomUtraM tAmravarRAyA nIlavarRABavaM Gftam .. daDi syAt kfzRavarRAyA darBodakasamAyutam . gomUtramAzakARyazwO gomayasya catuzwayam .. kzIrasya dbAdaSa proktA daDnastu daSa ucyate . Gftasya mAzakAH paYca paYcagavyaM malApaham ..” iti gAruqe prAyaScittaprakaraRam ..
paYcaguH, tri, paYcaBirgoBiH krItaH . iti mugDa- boDavyAkaraRe dbigusamAsaH ..

paYcaguptaH, puM, (paYcAnAmindriyARAM cApalyaM guptaM yatra . yadvA paYcAnAM padArTAnAM guptaH gopanaM yatra .) cArvvAkadarSanam . (karO caraRO Sira- Sceti paYcANgAni guptAni asya .) kacCapaH . iti medinI ..
paYcaguptirasA, strI, (paYcaDA guptO raso'syAH .) spfkkA . iti rAjanirGaRwaH ..

paYcacAmaram, klI, zoqaSAkzarapAdacCandoviSezaH . yaTA, -- “pramARikApadadvayaM vadanti paYcacAmaram ..” iti CandomaYjarI .. 4 .. (asyodAharaRamAha tatrEva . “suradrumUlamaRqape vicitraratnanirmmite lasadvitAnaBUzite salIlaviBramAlasam .. surANganABavallavIkaraprapaYcacAmara- sPuratsamIravIjitaM sadAcyutaM BajAmi tam ..”)
paYcacIraH, puM, (paYca cIrARyasya . bOdDaDarmmAva- lambi-jinaBedaH . paYca cIrARi svaraBedA asya .) maYjuGozaH . iti trikARqaSezaH ..

paYcacUqA, strI, (paYcasaNKakAH cUqAH SiroratnAni yasyAH .) apsaroviSezaH . iti purARam .. (yaTA, rAmAyaRe . 6 . 92 . 71 .  “urvvaSI menakA ramBA paYcacUqA tilottamA . upAnftyaMstu kAkutsTaM prahfzwA rakzaso vaDAt ..”)

paYcajanaH, puM, (paYcaBirBUtErjanyate'sO . paYca + jan + karmmaRi GaY . “janivaDyoSca” . 7 . 3 . 35 . iti na vfdDiH .) puruzaH . ityamaraH . 2 . 6 . 1 .. (yaTA, rAjataraNgiRyAm . 3 . 355 . “sadBAvaSryAdikA devyastena SrISabdalAYCitAH . paYca paYcajanendreRa pure tasmin niveSitAH ..”) dEtyaviSezaH . sa ca saMhrAdasya kftO patnyAM jAtaH . (yaTA, SrIBAgavate . 6 . 18 . 14 . “saMhrAdasya kftirBAryyA'sUta paYcajanaM tataH ..” aparo dEtyaBedaH . SrIkfzRaH enaM hatvA sAndI- panimunaye asya mftaM puttraM gurudakziRAsvarUpaM dadO . yaTA, BAgavate . 3 . 3 . 2 . “sAndIpaneH sakft proktaM brahmADItya savistaram . tasmE prAdAt varaM puttraM mftaM paYcajanodarAt ..”) asyAsTnA pAYcajanyanAmA SaNKo jAtaH . saca SrIkfzRasya . yaTA, -- “pAYcajanyaM hfzIkeSo devadattaM DanaYjayaH ..” ityAdi SrIBagavadgItAyAm . 1 . 15 .. (prajA- patiH . yaTA, BAgavate . 6 . 4 . 51 . “ezA paYcajanasyANga ! duhitA vE prajApateH . asiknI nAma patnItve prajeSa ! pratigfhyatAm ..” sagararAjaputtraH . yaTA, harivaMSe . 15 . 6 . “keSinyasUta sagarAdasamaYjasamAtmajam . rAjA paYcajano nAma baBUva sa mahAbalaH ..” ganDarbbAH pitaro devA asurA rakzAMsi paYcajana- padavAcyAni Bavanti . iti cintAmaRiH ..)
paYcajanI, strI, paYcAnAM janAnAM samAhAraH tato NIp . iti vyAkaraRam .. (viSvarUpakanyA . yaTA, BAgavate . 5 . 7 . 1 . “tadanuSAsanaparaH paYcajanIM viSvarUpaduhitaramupayeme ..”)

paYcajanInaH, puM, (paYcasu janezu vyApftaH . dik- saMKye saMjYAyAmiti samAsaH . paYcajane hitam . paYcajanAdupasaNKyAnamitiKaH . pAM . 5 . 1 . 9 . vArttike .) BaRqaH . iti halAyuDaH .. paYca- janasambanDini paYcajanyAH praBO ca tri ..
paYcajYAnaH, puM, (paYcAnAM padArTAnAM jYAnamasya .) budDaH . iti hemacandraH ..
paYcatakzam, klI, strI, paYcAnAM takzRAM samaAhAraH . iti vyAkaraRam ..

paYcatattvam, klI, (paYcAnAM tattvAnAM samAhAraH .) paYcaBUtam . iti svarodayaH .. paYcamakAraH . madya- mAMsamatsyamudrAmETunarUpam . yaTA, -- “madyaM mAMsaM taTA matsyaM mudrAM mETunameva ca . paYcatattvamidaM devi ! nirvvARamuktihetave .. makArapaYcakaM devi ! devAnAmapi durlaBam ..” iti kEvalyatantre praTamapawalaH .. vEzRavAnAM yaTA, -- “tattvajYAnamidaM proktaM vEzRave SfRu yatnataH . gurutattvaM mantratattvaM manastOttvaM sureSvari ! .. devatattvaM DyAnatattvaM paYcatattvaM varAnane ! . tatrAdO SrIgurostattvaM snehAdvakzyAmi pArvvati ! ..  satElaM varttikAyuktaM dehasTaM brahmatejasam . guruRA mantradAnena tatsUtraM dIpitaM Bavet .. devatAyAH SarIraM hi mantrAdutpadyate Druvam . ata eva hi tasyAtmA devarUpo na saMSayaH .. ISvarasya tu yadbIryyaM tadeva akzayAtmakam . tena varRAtmakaM dehaM jantoreva na saMSayaH .. mantravarRe sarvvavarRamayAste parameSvari ! . varRatattvamidaM devi ! sarvvasvaM mama yadBavet .. svayaM devo na cAnyo'smi nirmmalo devarUpakaH . sarvvatra devatAM DyAyet tfRagulmalatAdizu .. DyAnena laBate sarvvaM DyAnena vizRurUpakaH . DyAnena sidDimApnoti vinA DyAnaM na siDyati .. iti te kaTitaM tattvaM vEzRavasya sureSvari ! . yajjYAnAdamaratvaYca vizRurUpo BavennaraH .. te narA nahi gacCanti kadAcidyamamandiram ..” iti nirvvARatantre 12 pawalaH ..

paYcatapAH, [s] tri, (agnyAdiBiH paYcaBistejaH- padArTEstapati yaH . paYca + tap + asun .) agnicatuzwayasUryyapaYcakasADyatapoviSizwaH . yaTA, “tejasvimaDye tejasvI davIyAnapi gaRyate . paYcamaH paYcatapasastapano jAtavedasAm ..” iti mAGe . 2 . 52 ..
paYcatayam, tri, (paYca avayavA yasya . avayave tayap .) paYcAvayavam . iti vyAkaraRam ..
paYcatanmAtram, klI, (paYcaguRitaM SabdAdiBUtasUkzmA- tmakaM tanmAtram .) tAmasAhaNkArotpannamahA- BUtopAdAnakAraRaSabdasparSarUparasaganDAH . tadA- SrayadravyARi ca . iti sAMKyaBAzyam ..

paYcatA, strI, (paYcAnAM BUtAnAM BAvaH . pAYcaBOti- kasya SarIrasya paYcaDABAve AramBakARAM BUtAnAM tadBAvApattO satyAM OpacArikatvAt .) mftyuH . ityamaraH . 2 . 8 . 116 .. (yaTA, BAgavate . 7 . 8 . 52 . “sa tu janaparitApaM tatkftaM jAnatA te ! . narahara upanItaH paYcatAM paYcaviMSa ..”) dehAramBakARAM pfMTivyAdipaYcamahABUtAnAM svAMSasaMkramaRAt pfTaktvam . iti BarataH .. paYca- BAvaH . iti medinI .. (yaTA, manuH . 8 . 151 . “DAnyesadelave vAhye nAtikrAmati paYcatAm ..”)
paYcatiktam, klI, (paYcaguRitaM tiktam .) tiktadravya- paYcakam . yaTA . nimbAmftAvfzapawolanidi- gDikAH . ityAdi cakrapARidattaH ..

paYcatIrTI, strI, (paYcAnAM tIrTAnAM samahAraH . NIp .) tIrTapaYcakam . yaTA . “vizuvaddivase prApte paYcatIrTIviDAnataH .” iti tiTitattvam . paYcatIrTAnyAha . (tAni ca BinnadeSe Binna- rUpARi, tatra kASIsTAni . yaTA, kASIKaRqe . 100 . 39 -- 40 . “jYAnavApImupaspfSya nandikeSaM tato'rcayet . tArakeSaM tato'Byarcya mahAkAleSvaraM tataH .. tataH punardaRqapARimityezA paYcatIrTikA ..”)  puruzottamasTAni yaTA, -- “mArkaRqeye vawe kfzRe rOhiReye mahodaDO . indradyumnasaraH snAtvA punarjanma na vidyate ..” iti tIrTatattvam .. * .. api ca . nAnA- sTAnasTAni yaTA, -- “pfTivyAM yAni tIrTAni sarvvARyevABizecanAt . tatpaYcatIrTasnAnena samaM nAstyatra saMSayaH .. ekAdaSyAYca viSrAntO dvAdaSyAM SOkare taTA . trayodaSyAM nEmize ca prayAge ca caturddaSI .. kArttikyAM puzkare cEva kArttikasya sitAsite . kAlezvezu naraH snAtvA sarvvaM pApaM vyapohati ..” iti varAhapurARam ..

paYcatvam, klI, (paYcAnAM kzityAdiBUtAnAM BAvaH .) maraRam . paYcAnAM BAvaH . iti hemacandraH .. (“paYcaDAsamBftaH kAyo yadi paYcatvamAmataH . paYcaBiH svaSarIrotTEstatra kA parivedanA” .. taTA, BAgavate . 1 . 15 . 41 . “mftyAvapAnaM sotsargaM taM paYcatve hyajohavIt ..”)

paYcadaSaH, tri, paYcadaSAnAM pUraRaH . (pUraRe qaw . paYcADikA daSa yatra vA .) ponera ityAdi BAzA . tatsaMKyAmAtravAcitve nAntabahuvaca- nAnto'yam . iti vyAkaraRam .. tadvAcakaSabdaH . (yaTA, aTarvvavede . 11 . 1 . 19 . “pitAmahAH pitaraH prajopajAhaM paktvA paYcadaSaste asmi ..”) tiTiH . iti kavikalpalatA ..

paYcadaSI, strI, (paYcadaSAnAM pUraRI . qaw . NIp .) pUrRimA . amAvAsyA . iti medinI .. (yaTAha yAjYavalkyaH . 1 . 146 . “paYcadaSyAM caturddaSyAmazwamyAM rAhusUtake . ftusanDizu BuktvA vA SrAdDikaM pratigfhya ca ..” (paYcadaSaprakaraRAni santyasyAm .) SrImadBAratI- tIrTavidyAraRyamunISvarakfto vedAntagranTaviSezaH ..

paYcadIrGam, klI, (SarIrasya smftiSAstroktalakza- RakapaYcasTalaM dIrGaM paYcasu avayavezu dIrGalakza- RakamityarTaH .) SarIrapaYcAvayavalakzaRaviSezaH . yaTA, -- “bAhU netradbayaM kukzirdve tu nAse taTEva ca . stanayorantaraYcEva paYcadIrGaM praSasyate ..” iti sAmudrakam ..

paYcaDA, vya, (paYcan + “saMKyAyAviDArTe DA .” 5 . 3 . 42 . iti DA .) paYcaprakAram . iti vyAkaraRam .. (yaTA, BAgavate . 8 . 19 . 37 . “DarmmAya yaSase'rTAya kAmAya svajanAya ca . paYcaDA viBajan vittamihAmutra ca modate ..”)

paYcanaKaH, puM, (paYca naKA yasya .) hastI . kUrmmaH . iti hemacandraH .. vyAGraH . iti rAjanirGaRwaH .. * .. BakzaRIyapaYcanaKA yaTA, -- “SaSakaH SallakI goDA KaqgI kUrmmaSca paYcamaH ..” iti smftiH .. (taTAca yAjYavalkyaH . 1 . 177 . “BakzyAH paYcanaKAH seGAgoDAkacCapaSallakAH . SaSaSca matasyeyvapi hi siMhatuRqakarohitAH ..”)  “paYca paYcanaKA BakzyA ye proktAH kftajErdvijEH . kOSalyAja ! SaSAdInAM tezAM nEko'pyahaM kapiH ..” iti BawwiH . 6 . 131 ..

paYcanadaH, puM, (paYca paYcasaNKyAkAH nadyaH santyatra . samAse wac .) paYcanadIyuktadeSaviSezaH . paYjAva iti pArasyaBAzA . tasyanAmAntaram . vAhlIkaH madradeSaSca . tA nadyo yaTA . SatadruH 1 vipASA 2 irAvatI 3 candraBAgA 4 vitastA 5 . iti purARam .. (yaTA, rAjataraNgiRyAm . 4 . 248 . “rudDaH paYcanade jAtu dustarEH sinDusaNgamEH ..”) paYcAnAM nadInAM samAhAre klI .. (yaTA, rAmAyaRe . 3 . 43 . 21 . “tataH paYcanadaM kftsnaM vicetavyaM samantataH ..” tacca kASIsTanadIpaYcakarUpaM tIrTam . yaTA, kASIKaRqe . 59 . 113 -- 116 . “kiraRADUtapApe ca tasmin Darmmanade SuBe . sravantyO pApasaMharttryO vArARasyAM SuBadrave .. tato BAgIraTI prAptA tena dElIpinA saha . BAgIraTI samAyAtA yamunA ca sarasvatI .. kiraRADUtapApA ca puRyatoyA sarasvatI . gaNgA ca yamunA cEva paYcanadyo'tra kIrttitAH . ataH paYcanadaM nAma tIrTaM trElokyaviSutam ..” tIrTaviSezaH . yaTA, mahABArate . 3 . 82 . 79 . “aTa paYcanadaM gatvA niyato niyatASanaH . paYcayajYAnavApnoti kramaSo ye'nukIrttitAH ..” asuraBedaH . yaTA, harivaMSe . 120 . 88 . “hatvA paYcanadaM nAma narakasya mahAsuram ..”)

paYcanimbam, klI, (paYcAnAM svIyapuzpamUlAdi- rUpARAM nimbAnAM samAhAraH .) nimbavfkzasya- patratvakpuzpaPalamUlAni . iti rAjanirGaRwaH .. “paYcanimbantu tatpuzpamUlavalkaPalacCadEH ..” iti SabdacandrikA ..
paYcanI, strI, (paYcyate prapaYcyate pASakrIqA- niyamo yatra . paci vistAre + lyuw striyAM NIp .) SAriSfNKalA . iti SabdaratnAvalI .. (pASAra Cak iti BAzA ..)
paYcanIrAjanam, klI, paYcAnAM nIrAjanAnAM samA- hAraH . paYcaprakArArAtrikam . iti kAlottara- tantram .. asya vivaraRaM nIrAjanaSabde drazwavyam ..

paYcapakzI, [n] puM, (akArAdi-okArAntAH EueorUpAH paYcasvarAH pakziRaH pakzi- svarUpA yatra .) pAriBAzikapakzipaYcakadvArA trikAlaboDakapraSnagranTaH . yaTA, -- “praRamya SrImahAdebaM sarvvaSAstraviSAradam . BavizyadarTaboDAya papracCurmmunayo mudA .. tezAM vacanamAkarRya nijagAda maheSvaraH . trikAlajYAnaboDArTaM paYcapakzI pradarSyate .. anena SAstrasAreRa lokEH kAlatrayaM prati . balAbalAni dfSyante sarvvakAryyezu niScitaH .. AgataM pracCakaM dfzwvA dEvajYaH sAvaDAnataH . yadyat karoti karmmARi tasmAt sarvvaM vicArayet ..  kAke Boktari yAtrAyAM tAmracUqaH SiKI nfpaH . nidrAyAM ramate SyenaH kubjaH kAlavaSaM gataH .. * .. kubje Boktari yAtrAyAM vAyasaH kukkuwo nfpaH . nIlakaRWastaTA svApI Syeno mftyuvaSaM gataH ..” iti Suklapakzasya divAkramaH kfzRapakzasya rAtri- kramaSca .. * .. svaro'pi yaTA . ahipureBoH . gokaripure . ekonaripuH . upendro hariH . vizRuste lokaH .. * .. “ityuktaM pakziRAM kAryyaM lABAlABaM SuBASuBam . yena vijYAnamAtreRa trikAlajYo BavennaraH .. tAvadgarjjanti SAstrARi SakunAnAmanekaSaH . yAvanna SrUyate pakziSakunaM SaNkaroditam ..” iti SrImahAdevaviracitaM paYcapakziSAkunaM samAptam ..
paYcaparRikA, strI, (paYca paYca parRAnyasyAH . tataH kap kApi ataH itvam .) gorakzIkzupaH . iti rAjanirGaRwaH ..

paYcapallavam, klI, (paYcAnAM pallavAnAM samAhAraH .) AmrAdipatrapaYcakam . yaTA, -- “AmrajamvUkapitTAnAM bIjapUrakavilvayoH . ganDakarmmaRi sarvvatra patrARi paYcapallavam ..” iti SabdacandrikA .. vEdikakarmmaRi GawoparideyapaYcapallavaM yaTA, -- AmrASvatTavawaparkawIyajYoqumbarARi . tAntrika-H karmmaRi paYcapallavaM yaTA, -- “panasAmraM taTASvatTaM vawaM vakulameva ca . paYcapallavamuktaYca muniBistantravediBiH ..” iti tantrasAraH ..

paYcapAtram, klI, paYcAnAM pAtrARAM samAhAraH . iti vyAkaraRam .. paYcapAtrakaraRakapArvvaRaviDika- SrAdDam . tattu anvazwakASrAdDam . amAvasyA- mftapretapakzamftasAmbatsarikaM sapiRqIkaraRaYca . iti lokaprasidDam ..
paYcapittam, klI, (paYcaviDaM pittam .) pittapaYca- kam . yaTA, -- “varAhacCAgamahizamatsyamAyUrapittakam . paYcapittamiti KyAtaM sarvvezveva hi karmmasu ..” iti vEdyakam ..

paYcapradIpaH, puM, (paYcasaMKyakAH pradIpA yatra .) paYcadIpayuktArAtrikam . yaTA, -- “kuryyAt saptapradIpena SaNKaGaRwAdivAdyakEH . hareH paYcapradIpena bahuSo BaktitatparaH ..” iti pAdmottaraKaRqe 107 aDyAyaH ..

paYcaprAsAdaH, puM, (prasIdanti manAMsi atra . pra + sada + aDikaraRe GaY . “upasargasya dIrGatvaM kvipGaYAdO kvacidBavet .” iti vacanAt dIrGaH . paYcacUqAnvitaH prAsAdaH . maDyapadalopikarmmaDArayaH .) devagfhaviSezaH . paYcaratna iti KyAtaH . yaTA, -- “pakvezwakacitaM ramyaM paYcaprAsAdasaMyutam . kArayitvA harerDAma DUtapApo vrajeddivam ..” ityagnipurARam ..

paYcabanDaH, puM, (paYcamaH vanDaH BAgo yatra .) nazwa- dracyasya paYcamAMSadaRqaH . yaTA, -- “AMgamenopaBogena nazwaM BAvyamato'nyaTA . paYcananDo damastasya rAjYe tenAviBAvite ..” Agamena rikTakrayAdinA . upaBogena ca madIyamidaM dravyaM taccEvaM nazwamapahftaM vetyapi . BAvyaM sADanIyaM tat svAminA . ato'nyaTA tena svAminA aviBAvite . paYcabanDo nazwa- dravyasya paYcamAMSo damo nAzwikena rAjYaM deyaH . iti mitAkzarA ..

paYcaBadraH, puM, (paYcasu aNgaBedezu BadraH SuBaH puzpitatvAt .) paYcasTAnezu puzpito'Sva- viSezaH . yaTA, -- “paYcaBadrastu hftpfzWamuKapArSvezu puzpitaH ..” iti hemacandraH .. pAcanaviSezaH . yaTA, -- “CinnodBavAparpawavArivAha- BUnimbaSuRWIjanitaH kazAyaH . samIrapittajvarajarjjarARAM karoti BadraM Kalu paYcaBadraH ..” iti SArNgaDaraH ..

paYcaBUtam, klI, paYcAnAM BUtAnAM kzityaptejomaru- dvyomnAM samAhAraH . (kecittu saMjYAprayuktatvAt paYca ca tAni BUtAni ceti karmmaDArayasamAsa- mAhustatra tu ekavacanaYcintanIyam .) asyotpattiryaTA . “aBUttasmAdahaNkArastriviDaH sfzwiBedataH . vEkArikAdahaNkArAddevA vEkArikA daSa .. digvAtArkapraceto'SvivahnIndropendramitrakAH . tEjasAdindriyARyAsaMstanmAtrA kramayogataH . BUtAdikAdahaNkArAt paYcaBUtAni jajYire ..” iti SAradAyAM praTamapawalaH .. * .. “so'haNkArastriBedaH syAt sattvAdiguRayogataH . vEkAraH sAttviko nAma tEjaso rAjasaH smftaH .. BUtAdistAmasaste ca pfTaktattvAdyavAsfjan . vEkArikAddigAdyASca candreREkAdaSa smftAH .. indriyARAmaDizWAtfdevAste parikIrttitAH . yaccAparaM manastattvaM sasaNkalpavikalpakam .. tEjasAdeva tajjAtamindriyARi taTA daSa . BUtAdeH paYcatanmAtrARyAsan BUtamataH param ..” iti rAGavaBawwaDftam .. * .. “SabdAdvyomasparSatastena vAyu- stAByAM rUpAdvahniretE rasAcca . amBAMsyetErganDato BUrDarAdyA BUtAH paYca syurguRonAH krameRa ..” iti prapaYcasAre praTamapawalaH .. * .. “AkASAjjAyate vAyurvAyorutpadyate raviH . raverutpadyate toyaM toyAdutpadyate mahI ..” (taTA ca SrutiH . “tasmAdetasmAdAkASaH samBUtaH . AkASAdvAyuH vAyoragniragnerApo'dByaH pfTvI samajAyata ..” etacCru tyavalambanena manunApyuktam . 1 . 20 . yaTA, --  “AdyAdyasya guRantvezAmavApnoti paraHparaH . yo yo yAvatiTaScEzAM sa sa tAvadguRaH smftaH ..” atra kullUkaBawwaH . “AdyAdyasyAkASAderguRaM SabdAdikaM vAyvAdiH paraH paraH prApnoti . etadeva spazwayati yo yaH iti yezAM maDye yo yo yAvatAM pUraRA yAva- tiTaH vatoriTuk sa sa dbitIyAdiH dbitIyo dviguRaH tftIyastriguRaH ityevamAdirmanvAdiBiH smftaH . etenEtaduktaM Bavati . BagaliNgasya yogena mETunaM yadBavet priye ! . tasya nAma Baveddevi ! paYcamaM parikIrttitam .. praTamantu BavenmadyaM mAMsaYcEva dbitIyakam . matsyaScEva tftIyaM syAnmudrA cEva caturTikA .. paYcamaM paYcamaM vidyAt paYca te nAmataH smftAH ..” iti samayAcAratantre 2 pawalaH .. * .. aTa matsyAdivyutpattiH . “mAyAmalAdiSamanAnmokzamArganirUpaRAt . azwaduHKAdivirahAnmatsyeti parikIrttitaH .. mANgalyajananAddevi ! sambidAnandadAnataH . sarvvadevapriyatvAcca mAMsa ityaBiDIyate .. paYcamaM devi ! sarvvezu mama prARapriyaM Bavet . paYcamena vinA devi ! caRqImantraM kaTaM japet .. yadi paYcamakArezu BrAntiYcet kurute priye ! . tasya sidDiH kaTaM devi ! caRqImantraM kaTaM japet .. paYcamahAyajYAH, puM, (paYcaviDA mahAyajYAH .) gfhasTakarttavyapaYcaprakAranityakarmmARi . yaTA, -- “pAWo homaScAtiTInAM saparyyA tarpaRaM valiH . etEH paYca mahAyajYA brahmayajYAdinAmakEH ..” ityamaraH . 2 . 7 . 14 .. (taTA ca manuH . 3 . 68-70 . “paYcasUnA gfhasTasya cUllIpezaRyupaskaraH . kaRqanI codakumBaSca baDyate yAstu vAhayan .. tAsAM krameRa sarvvAsAM nizkftyarTaM mahAtmaBiH . paYcakxptA mahAyajYAH pratyahaM gfhameDinAm .. aDyApanaM brahmayajYaH pitfyajYastu tarpaRam . homo dEvo valirBOto nfyajYo'tiTipUjanam ..”)

paYcamI, strI, (paYcAnAM pARqavAnAM iyam . aTavA paYca patIn minoti sevAsnehAdiBirbaDnAti yA . paYca + mI + kvip . mIDAturatra banDArTaH .) pARqavapatnI . drOpadI . iti medinI .. paYcamIvratam, klI, (paYcamyAM mAGaSuklapaYcamImAraBya zaqvarzaM yAvat pratimAsIyaSuklapaYcamyAM striyA  tasyAH SrIrniScalA gehe satyaM satyaM hi nArada ! .. yaTendrARI mahendrasya lakzmIrlakzmIpateryaTA . BUmidAnaM tato dadyAt paYcalANgalakAnvitam .. karvvawaM KewakaYcApi grAmaM vA SasyaSAlinam . nivarttanaSataM vApi tadardDvaM vApi SaktitaH .. sAradArumayAn kftvA halAn paYca vicakzaRaH . sarvvopakaraREryuktAnanyAn paYca ca kAYcanAn .. vfzalakzaRasaMyuktAn daSEva tu DuranDarAn . suvarRaSfNgABaraRAn muktAlANgUlaBUzitAn .. rOpyapAdAgratilakAnraktakOSeyaBUzaRAn . sragdAmacandanayutAn SAlAyAmaDivAsayet .. parjjanyAdityarudreByaH pAyasaM nirvvapet carum . ekasminneva kuRqe tu gururyasminnivedayet .. pAlASAH samiDastadvadAjyaM kfzRatilAMstaTA . tulApuruzavat kuryyAt lokeSAvAhanaM buDaH .. tato maNgalaSabdena yuktamAlyAmbaro buDaH . BavanasTAnamAtraM vA so'pi pApEH pramucyate .. yAvanti lANgalakamArgamuKAni BUme- stAsAM patirduhituraNgajaromakARi . tAvanti SaNkarapure varzARi tizWe- dBUmipradAnamaTa yaH kurute manuzyaH .. ganDarvvakinnarasurAsurasidDasaMGE- rADUtacAmaramupetya mahAdbamAnam . sampUjyate pitfpitAmahabanDuyuktaH SamBoH puraM vrajati cAmaranAyakaH san .. indratvamapyaDigataM kzayamaByupEti goBUmilANgalaDuranDarasaMpradAnAt . tasmAdaGOGapawalakzayakAriBUme- rddAnaM viDeyamiti BUtiBavABavAya ..” iti mAtsye 257 aDyAyaH ..
paYcaloham, klI, (paYcaM vistIrRaM loham .) sOrAzwraka- loham . iti hemacandraH .. (paYcaguRitaM loham . suvarRarajatatAmrasIsakaraNgARi ..)

paYcavaktraH, puM, (paYca vaktrARi yasya .) SivaH . (“viSvAdyaM viSvabIjaM niKilaBayaharaM paYcavaktraM trinetram ..” iti SivaDyAnam ..) asya mantrA yaTA, -- “samastAnAM svarARAntu dIrGAH SezAH sabindukAH . FnFkaSUnyAH sArdDacandrA upAnte nABisaMhitAH .. eBiH paYcAkzarErmmantraM paYcavaktrasya kIrttitam . kramAt sammadasandohamAdagOravasaMjYakAH .. prAsAdantu Bavet SezaM paYcamantrAH prakIrttitAH . ekEkena taTEvEkaM vaktraM mantreRa pUjayet .. ekaM samuditaM kftvA paYcaBirvvA prapUjayet . prAsAdenATavA paYcavaktraM devaM prapUjayet .. sammadAdizu mantrezu prAsAdantu praSasyate . SamBoH prasAdanenEva yasmAdavfttastu mantrakaH .. tena prAsAdasaMjYo'yaM kaTyate munipuNgavEH . tasmAt sarvvezu mantrezu prAsAdaH prItidaH praBoH .. AmodakArakaH SamBormmantraH sammada ucyate . manaHprapUraRaScApi sandohaH parikIrttitaH .. Akarzako BavenmAdo gurutvAdgOravAhvayaH . etadvyastaM samastaYca mantraM SamBoH prakIrttitam .. paYcAkzaraYca yanmantraM paYcavaktrasya kIrttitam . svayantenEva mantreRa ArADayatamISvaram .. * .. DyAnaYca SfRu vakzyAmi samyagvetAlaBaravO . paYcavaktraM mahAkAyaM jawAjUwaviBUzitam .. cArucandrakalAyuktaM mUrdDni vyAlOGasaMgatam . bAhuBirddaSaBiryuktaM vyAGracarmmAsvarAmbaram .. kAlakUwaDaraM kaRWe nAgahAropaSABitam . kowIrabanDanaM bAhuBUzaRaYca BujaNgamAH .. viBUtiM sarvvagAtrezu jyotsnArpitasvarocizam . BUtisaMliptasarvvANgamekEkatra triBistriBiH .. netrEstu paYcadaSaBirjyotizmadBirviBUzitam . vfzaBopari saMsTantu gajakfttiparicCadam .. sadyojAtaM vAmadevamaGoraYca tataH param . tatpuruzaM yaTeSAnaM paYcavaktraM prakIrttitam .. sadyojAtaM BavedbaktraM SudDasPawikasanniBam . pItavarRaM taTA sOmyaM vAmadevaM manoharam .. nIlavarRamaGorantu daMzwrABItivivardDanam . raktaM tatpuruzaM devaM divyamUrttiM manoharam .. SyAmalaYca taTeSAnaM sarvvadEva SivAtmakam . cintayet paScime tvAdyaM dvitIyaYca taTottare .. aGoraM dakziRe devaM pUrbbe tatpuruzantaTA . ISAnaM maDyato DyeyaM cintayedBaktitatparaH .. SaktitriSUlaKawvANgavaradABayadaM Sivam . dakziRezvaTa hastezu vAmezvapi tataH SfRu .. akzasUtraM bIjapUraM BujagaM qamarUtpalam . azwESvaryyasamAyuktaM DyAyettu hfdgataM Sivam ..” iti kAlikApurARe 50 aDyAyaH .. * .. paYcamuKarudrAkzaH . yaTA skAndre, -- “paYcavaktraH svayaM rudraH kAlAgnirnAma nAmataH . agamyAgamanAccEva aBakzyasya ca BakzaRAt .  mucyate sarbbapApeByaH paYcavaktrasya DAraRAt ..” iti tiTitattvam .. (paYcaM vistftaM vaktraM vadanaM yasya . iti vigrahe . siMhaH ..)

paYcavawaH, puM, (paYco vistIrRo vawaH .) uraskawaH . tatparyyAyaH . jowiNgaH 2 mahAvratI 3 bAla- yajYopavItakam 4 . iti trikARqaSezaH .. (paYca- saMKyakA vawA aSbatTavilvavawaDAttrya Soka- rUpA vfkzA yasmin . paYcavawIvanam . yaTA rAmAyaRe . 1 . 3 . 13 . “samAgamaM virADena vAsaM paYcavawe taTA ..”)

paYcavawI, strI, (paYcAnAM vawAnAM samAhAraH . tadDitArTeti tatpuruzaH saMKyApUrbbodbigururiti dvigusaMjYAyAM “dvigoH” . 4 . 1 . 21 . iti NIz . dvigurekavacanamiti ekavacanam .) paYcaprakAra- vfkzaviSezaH . yaTA, -- “aSvatTavilvavfkzaYca vawaDAtrIaSokakam . vawIpaYcakamityuktaM sTApayet paScadikzu ca .. aSvatTaM sTApayet prAci vilvamuttaraBAgataH . vawaM paScimaBAge tu DAtrIM dakziRatastaTA .. aSokaM vahnidiksTApyaM tapasyArTaM sureSvari . maDye vedIM caturhastAM sundarIM sumanoharAm .. pratizWAM kArayettasyAH paYcavarzottaraM Sive ! . anantaPaladAtrI sA tapasyAPaladAyinI .. * .. iyaM paYcavatI proktA bfhatpaYcavawIM SfRu . vilvavfkzaM maDyaBAge caturddikzu catuzwayam .. vawavfkzaM catuzkoRe vedasaMKyaM praropayet . aSokaM vattulAkAraM paYcaviMSatisammitam .. digvidikzvAmalakIYcEva ekEkaM parameSvari . aSvatTaYca caturddikzu bfhatpaYcavawI Bavet .. yaH karoti maheSAni ! sAkzAdindrasamI Bavet . iha loke mantrasidDiH pare ca paramA gatiH ..” iti hemAdrIyavrataKaRqaDftaskandapurARavacanAni .. (svanAmaKyAtaH pradeSaviSezaH . yaTA, rAmAyaRe . 1 . 1 . 45 . “deSaH paYcavawInAma tatra vAsaM sa kalpayat ..”)

paYcavalkalam, klI, (paYcAnAM valkalAnAM samA- hAraH .) valkalapaYcakam . yaTA, -- “nyagroDoqumbarASvatTaplakzavetasavalkalEH . sarvvErekatra saMyuktEH paYcavalkalamucyate ..” api ca . “nyagroDoqumbarASvatTaplakzapippalapItanAH . kzIrivfkzASca paYcEzAM valkalaM paYcavalkalam ..” iti SabdacandrikA .. asya guRAH . “paYcEte kzIriRo vfkzAstezAM tvak paYcalakzaRam . tvakpaYcakaM himaM grAhi vraRaSoTavisarpajit ..” iti rAjanirGaRwaH ..

paYcavARaH, puM, (paYca vARAH SarA yasya saH .) kAmadevaH . iti hemacandraH .. paYcAnAM vARAnAM samAhAre klI . (kAmasya paYca vARA yaTA, -- “dravaRaM SozaRaM vARaM tApanaM mohanABiDam .  unmAdanaYca kAmasya vARAH paYca prakIrttitAH ..” paYcapuzpavARA yaTA, -- “aravindamaSokaYca cUtaYca navamallikA . nIlotpalaYca paYcEte paYcavARasya sAyakAH ..”) paYcavARaviSizwe tri ..

paYcaSaraH, puM, (paYca SarA yasya saH .) kandarpaH . ityamaraH . 1 . 1 . 26 .. asya paYca SarARi yaTA, brahmavEvartte SrIkfzRajanmaKaRqe 32 aDyAye . “sammohanaM samudvegabIjaM stamBanakAraRam . unmattabIjaM jvalanaM SaSvaccetanahArakam ..” api ca . “sammohanonmAdanO ca SozaRastApanastaTA . stamBanaSceti kAmasya paYca vARAH prakIrttitAH ..” paYca indriyArTAH SarA asyetyanye . iti BarataH .. (yaTA, kumAre . 7 . 92 . “SApAvasAne pratipannamUrtte- ryayAcire paYcaSarasya sevAm ..”)
paYcaSasyam, klI, (paYcAnAM SasyAnAM samAhAraH .) SasyapaYcakam . tattu DAnyamudgatilayavaSvetasarzapa- rUpam . sarzapasTAne mAzo'pi . iti durgot- savapadDatiH ..
paYcaSAKaH, puM, (paYca SAKA ivANgulayo yasya .) hastaH . ityamaraH . 2 . 6 . 81 .. paYcAnAM SAKAnAM samAhAre klI . paYcaSAKAviSizwetri ..

paYcaSiKaH, puM, (paYcA vistIrRA SiKA keSa- rAdiryasya .) siMhaH . iti hemacandraH .. Darmmasya hiMsABAryyAyAM jAto muniviSezaH . yaTA, -- “Darmmasya BAryyA hiMsAKyA tasyAM puttracatuzwayam . samprAptaM muniSArddUla ! yogaSAstravicArakam .. jyezWaH sanatkumAro'BUddvirtIyaSca sanAtanaH . tftIyaH sanako nAma caturTaSca sanandanaH .. sAMKyavettAramaparaM kapilaM voQumAsurim . dfzwvA paYcaSiKaM SrezWaM yogayuktaM taponiDim .. jYAnayogaM na te dadyurjyAyAMso'pi kanIyasAm ..” iti vAmane 50 aDyAyaH .. (asya anyaprakArotpattirnAmaniruktiSca uktA mahABArate . 12 . 218 . 6 -- 19 . “tatra paYcaSiKo nAma kApileyo mahAmuniH . pariDAvan mahIM kftsnAM jagAma miTilAmaTa .. sarvvasannyAsaDarmmARAM tattvajYAnaviniScaye . suparyyavasitArTaSca nirdvandvo nazwasaMSayaH .. fzIRAmAhurekaM yaM kAmAdavasitaM nfzu . SASvataM suKamatyantamanvicCantaM sudurllaBam .. yamAhuH kapilaM sAMKyAH paramarzi prajApatim . sa manye tena rUpeRa vismApayati hi svayam .. AsureH praTamaM SizyaM yamAhuScirajIvinam . paYcasrotasi yaH rAtramAste varzasahasrikam .. yatra cAsInamAgamya kApilaM maRqalaM mahat . puruzAvasTamavyaktaM paramArTaM nyavedayat .. izwasatreRa saMpfzWo BUyaSca tapasAsuriH . kzetrakzetrajYayorvvyaktiM bubaDe devadarSanaH ..  yattadekAkzaraM brahma nAnArUpaM pradfSyate . AsurirmmaRqale tasmin pratipede tadavyayam .. tasya paYcaSiKaH Sizyo mAnuzyA payasA BftaH .. brAhmaRI kapilA nAma kAcidAsIt kuwumbinI . tasyAH puttratvamAgamya striyAH sa pibati stanO .. tataH sa kApileyatvaM leBe budDiYca nEzWikIm . etatte BagavAnAha kApileyasya samBavam .. tasya tat kApileyatvaM sarvvavittvamanuttamam .. sAmAnyaM janakaM jYAtvA DarmmajYo jYAnamuttamam . upetya SatamAcAryyAnmohayAmAsa hetuBiH .. janakastvaBisaMraktaH kApileyAnudarSanAt . utsfjya SatamAcAryyAn pfzWato'nujagAma tam .. paYcasrotasi nizRAtaH paYcarAtraviSAradaH . paYcajYaH paYcakft paYcaguRaH paYcaSiKaH smftaH ..” gAyatrIsvarUpAyAM SaktyAM strI . yaTA, devI- BAgavate . 12 . 6 . 105 . “pAnapriyA paYcaSiKA pannagopariSAyinI ..”)

paYcaSUraRaH, puM, (paYca SUraRA yatra .) paYcaprakAra- SUraRaH . tadyaTA . atyamlaparRI kARqIraH mAlAkandaH SUraRaH SbetaSUraRaSca . taTAhi . “atyamlaparRIkARqIramAlAkandadbiSUraREH . kxpto Bavati yogo'yaM paYcaSUraRasaMjYakaH ..” iti rAjanirGaRwaH ..

paYcasuganDakam, klI, (paYca suganDA yatra . tataH kap .) paYcaprakAramuganDidravyam . yaTA, -- “kusumAni lavaNgasya taTA kakkolakARqayoH . jAtIPalAni karpUrametat paYcasuganDakam ..” iti SabdacandrikA .. api ca . “karpUrakakkolalavaNgapuzpa- guvAkajAtIPalapaYcakena . samAMSaBAgena ca yojitena manoharaM paYcasuganDakaM syAt ..” iti rAjanirGaRwaH ..

paYcasUnA, strI, (paYcaguRitA sUnA prARivaDa- sTAnam .) paYcaprakAraprARivaDasTAnam . yaTA, -- “paYcasUnA gfhasTasya cullI pezaRyupaskaraH . kaRqanI codakumBaSca baDyate yASca vAhayan ..” iti SudDitattvam .. tajjanyapApaM gfhasTasya pratidinaM Bavati tasya  prAyaScittaM vESyadevaH . yaTA, -- “lOkike vEdike vApi hutocCizwe jale kzitO . vESvadevantu kurvvIta paYcasUnApanuttaye ..” iti AhnikatattvaDftaSAtAtapavacanam .. aSOcakAlotpannapaYcasUnAdijanyapApasya dAnA- dinASyatvaM yaTA, -- “daSAhAttuparaM samyak vipro'DIyIta Darmmavit . dAnaYca viDinA deyamaSuBAttArakaM hi tat ..” iti SudDitattvaDftasambarttavacanam ..

paYcasvarA, strI, (paYca svarA yatra .) prajApati- dAsavEdyakftaSiSurizwamAtfrizwapitfrizwastrIpuMna- . puMsakajYAnasuKaduHKarizwacCedAdiyogamftyujYAna- nirRaya iti saptADyAyAtmakajyotirgranTaviSezaH yaTA . tatrEva . “paYcasvarABiDAnaYca granTaM nidAnasammatam . kiYciduddeSagamyaYca svalyaM vakzyAmi SASvatam ..”

paYcasvarodayaH, puM, (paYcAnAM svarARAmudayo yatra .) jyotiHSAstraviSezaH . yaTA, -- “kAlaM vakzyAmi saMsidDyO rudra paYcasvarodayAt . rAjA mAjA udAsA ca pIqA mftyustaTEva ca .. A i U E O svarASca liKet paYcAgnikozWake . UrdDatiryyaggatEreKEH zaqvahnikramamAgatEH .. tiTI ekAgnikozWezu trayo rAjATa mAjayA . udAsA pIqA mftyuSca kujaH somasutaH kramAt .. guruSukraSanEScararavicandrA yaToditam . revatyAdiSivAntASca FkzASca praTamAH kalAH .. paYcapaYcAnyatra BAni cEtrAdya udayastaTA . dvAdaSAhA dvayo mAsA nAmna AdyakzaraM taTA .. kalA liNgaYca yA tizWet paYcamastasya vEmftiH . lakA tiTistaTA vAranakzatraM mAsameva ca .. nAmodayasya pUrbbaYca taTA Bavati nAnyaTA ..” iti garuqapurARam ..

paYcAgni, klI, paYcAnAmagnInAM samAhAraH . asya viMvaraRaM paYcAtapASabde drazwavyam .. SarIrasTa- paYcAgnayo yaTA, -- “udare gArhapatyAgnirmaDyadeSe tu dakziRaH . Asya Ahavano'gniSca satyaH parvvA ca mUrdDani . yaH paYcAgnInimAn veda AhitAgniH sa ucyate ..” iti garuqapurARam .. (paYcAgnayo gfhe yasya . iti vigrahe vAcya- liNgatvam . yaTA manuH . 3 . 185 . “triRAciketaH paYcAgnistrisuparRazaqaNgavit ..”)

paYcANgam, klI, paYcAnAM aNgAnAM ekavfkzasya tvak- patrapuzpamUlaPalAnAM samAhAraH . yaTA, -- “tvakpatrakusumaM mUlaM Palamekasya SAKinaH . ekatra militaYcEtat paYcANgamiti saMjYitam ..” iti rAjanirGaRwaH .. puraScaraRaviSezaH . yaTA, -- “japahomO tarpaRaYcABizeko vipraBAjanam . paYcANgopAsanaM loke puraScaraRamizyate ..” iti tantrasAraH .. vAratiTinakzatrayogakaraRAtmakapaYjikA . yaTA, --  “tiTirvAraSca nakzatraM yogaH karaRameva ca . paYcANgasya PalaM SrutvA gaNgAsnAnaPalaM laBet” .. iti jyotizam ..

paYcANgaH, puM, (paYcANgARi yasya .) kamaWaH . iti SabdamAlA .. aSvaviSezaH . tatparyyAyaH . paYca- BadraH 2 puzpitaturaNgamaH 3 . iti SabdaratnAvalI .. praRAmaviSezaH . yaTA, -- “bAhuByAYcEva jAnuByAM SirasA vacasA dfSA . paYcANgo'yaMpraRAmaH syAt pUjAsu pravarAvimO ..” iti tantrasAraH .. (rAjanayaH . yaduktam . “sahAyAH sADanopAyA viBAgo deSakAlayoH . vinipAtapratIkAraH sidDiH paYcANga izyate ..”)
paYcANgaguptaH, puM, (paYcasaMKyakAni aNgAni guptAni yasya .) kacCapaH . iti trikARqaSezaH ..
paYcANgulaH, puM, (paYca aNgulaya iva patrARi yasya .) eraRqavfkzaH . ityamaraH . 2 . 4 . 51 . paYcA- NgulaparimARayukte tri ..
paYcANguliH, tri, paYcANgulayo yasya saH . iti vyAkaraRam ..

paYcAtapA, strI, (paYcaBiragnisUryyErAtapyate iti . AN + tap + ac . tataH wAp .) tapasyA- viSezaH . yaTA, -- “caryyA paYcAtapAcintA SAmBavI SAmBavo japaH . yajYiyErdAruBiH SuzkEScaturddikzu catuzkftam .. vahnisaMsTApanaM grIzme tIvrAMSustatra paYcamaH . hastAntare caturvvahnIn kftvA vESvAnarezwinA .. tanmaDyasTA sUryyavimbaM vIkzantI bahulAMSukA .” iti kAlikApurARe 42 aDyAyaH ..

paYcAmarAH, strI, (paYca amarAH . saMjYAtvAtkarmma- DArayaH .) paYcaprakArAmaralatAdi . yaTA, -- “ekA tu amarA dUrvvA tasyA granTiM samAnayet . anyA tu vijayA devI sidDirUpA sarasvatI .. anyA tu vilvapatrasTA SivasantozakAriRI . anyA tu yogasidDyarTe nirguRqI cAmarA latA .. anyA tu kAlatulasI SrIvizRoH priyatoziRI . etAH paYcAmarA jYeyA yogasADanakarmmaRi ..” iti rudrayAmalottaraKaRqe 36 pawalaH ..

paYcAmftam, klI, (paYcAnAmamftAnAM samAhAraH . SarkarAdugDaGftadaDimaDuGawitam . yaTA, -- “dugDaM saSarkaraYcEva GftaM daDi taTA maDu . paYcAmftAmadaM proktaM viDeyaM sarvvakarmmasu ..”  garBavatIByastaddAnasya dinaM yaTA, -- “revatyaSvipunarvvasudvayamarunmralAnurADAmaGA- hastAsUttaraPalgunIzu Bfguje jIvArkavAre taTA . lagnarkzoqupaSoBanezu niyataM santyajya riktAM tiTiM deyaM mAsi ca paYcamezu karaRe paYcAmftaM yozi- tAm ..” iti jyotistattvam ..

paYcAmftayogaH, puM, (paYcAnAmamftAnAM guqucyAdInAM yogaH .) guqucIgokzuramuSalImuRqikASatAva- rIrRA saMyogaH . yaduktaM rAjanirGaRwe . “guqUcI gokzuraYcEva muSalI muRqikA taTA . SatAvarIti paYcAnAM yogaH paYcAmftABiDaH ..”

paYcAmnAyaH, puM, (paYcasaMKyakaH AmnAyaH .) vizRuDarmmaH, puM, (vizRupraDAno Darmmo'smin .) SAstra- viSezaH . yaTA . “brahmacArikARqe Bavizya- purARam . ‘azwAdaSa purARAni rAmasya caritaM taTA .  vizRuDarmmAdiSAstrARi SivaDarmmASca BArata .. kArzRyaYca paYcamo vedo yanmahABArataM smftam . sOrASca DarmmA rAjendra mAnavoktA mahIpate . jayeti nAma etezAM pravadanti manIziRaH ..’ jayatyanena saMsAramiti jayastattadgranTaH ..” iti tiTAditattvam .. * .. vidyAviSezaH . yaTA, -- “avApa japtvA cendratvaM vizRuDarmmAKyavidyayA . sarvvAn SatrUn vinirjitya tAYca vakzye maheSvara .. pAdayorjAnunorUrvvorudare hfdyaTorasi . muKe SirasyAnupUrbbAdoNkArAdiM vinirddiSet .. o~ namo nArAyaRAyeti viparyyayamaTApi vA . karanyAsaM tataH kuryyAt dvAdaSAkzaravidyayA .. praRavAdiyakArAntamaNgulyaNguzWaparvvasu . nyasyet hfdaya o~kAraM nakAraM mama mUrdDani .. mokArantu BruvormmaDye SiKAnetrAdimUrdDataH . o~ vizRave nama iti imaM mantramudAharet .. vizRupaYjaram, klI, (vizRureva paYjaramiva yasmin . tadDArayiturnirBayarakzaRakAritvAdasya taTAtvam .) vizRu kaMvacaviSezaH . yaTA, -- “pravakzyAmyaDunA tvetadbEzRavaM paYjaraM SuBam . namo namaste govinda cakraM gfhya sudarSanam .. prAcyAM rakzasva mAM vizRo tvAmahaM SaraRaM gataH . gadAM kOmodakIM gfhya padmanABAmitadyute .. yAmyAM rakzasva mAM vizRo tvAmahaM SaraRaM gataH .  halamAdAya sOnandaM namaste puruzottama . pratIcyAM rakza mAM vizRo BavantaM SaraRAgatam .. pAYcajanyaM taTA SaNKaM SArNgaYcApyaTa paNkajam . pragfhya rakza mAM vizRo AgneyyAM yajYaSUkara .. carmma sUryyaSataM gfhya KaqgaM candrasamaM taTA . nErftyAM mAYca rakzasva divyamUrtte nfkeSarin .. vEjayantIM pragfhya tvaM SrIvatsyakaRWaBUzaRa . vAyavyAM rakza mAM deva aSvaSIrza namo'stu te .. vEnateyaM samAruhya antarIkze janArddana . mAM tvaM rakzAjita sadA namaste'stvaparAjita .. viSAlAkzaM samAruhya rakza mAM tvaM rasAtale . akUpAra namastuByaM mahAmIna namo'stu te .. karaSIrzANGrisarvvezu taTAzwaBujapaYjaram . kftvA tvaM rakza mAM deva namaste puruzottama .. etaduktaM BagavatA vEzRavaM paYjaraM mahat . purA rakzArTamISena kAtyAyanyA dbijottama .. yadA sA nASayAmAsa dAnavaM mahizAsuram . cAmaraM raktabIjaYca taTAnyAn surakaRwakAn ..” iti vAmane 17 aDyAyaH ..

vizRuBaktiH, strI, (vizRO BaktiH .) (yaTA, raGuH . 1 . 10 . “taM santaH Srotumarhanti sadasadvyaktihetavaH . hemnaH saMlakzyate'hyagnO viSudDiH SyAmikApi vA ..” BUtamAtram . yaTA, gItAyAm . 8 . 18 . “avyaktAdvyaktayaH sarvvAH praBavantyaharAgame ..” “vyaktayaScarAcarARi BUtAni .” iti tawwI- kAyAM svAmI .. nyAyaSAstroktastattatpadArTaH . yaTA, sAhityadarpaRe . 2 . 25 . “sAmarTyamOcitI deSaH kAlo vyaktiH svarAdayaH . SabdArTasyAnavacCede viSezasmftihetavaH ..”)

vyagraH, tri, (virudDaM agatIti . aga + fjre- ndreti sADuH .) vyAsaktaH . (yaTA, mahA- nirvvARatantre . 3 . 124 . “lubDA DanArjane vyagrAH sadA caYcalamAnasAH ..”) AkulaH . ityamaraH .. (yaTA, kumAre . 7 . 2 . “vEvAhikEH kOtukasaMviDAnE- rgfhe gfhe vyagrapuranDrivargam ..”  sasamBramaH . iti SrIDarasvAmI .. yaTA, BAga- vate . 3 . 19 . 5 . “taM vyagracakraM ditijADamena svapArzadamuKyena visarjjamAnam ..”) puM, vizRuH . yaTA, -- “pragraho nigraho vyagro nEkaSfNgo gadAgrajaH .” iti tasya sahasranAmastotram ..

vyaNgaH, puM, (vikftAni aNgAni yasya .) BekaH . iti medinI .. (vikftAni aNgAni yasmAt .) muKarogaviSezaH . tasya lakzaRaM yaTA, -- “kroDAyAsaprakupito vAyuH pittena saMyutaH . muKamAgamya sahasA maRqalaM visfjatyataH . nIrujaM tanukaM SyAvaM muKe vyaNgaM tamAdiSet ..” iti mADavakaraH .. * .. tasya cikitsA . “vawANkurA masUrASca pralepAdbyaNganASanaH . vyaNge maYjizWayA lepaH praSasto maDuyuktayA .. aTavA lepanaM SastaM SaSasya ruDireRa ca . jAtIPalasya lepastu haredvyaNgaYca nIlikAm .. vawasya pARqupatrARi mAlatI raktacandanam . kuzWaM kAlIyakaM loDraM eBirllepaM prayojayet ..” iti BAvaprakASaH .. (tri, vigataM aNgaM yasya .) hInANgaH . iti medinI .. (yaTA, mahABArate . 1 . 16 . 20 . “yadyenamapi mAtastvaM mAmivARqaviBedanAt . na karizyasyanaNgaM vA vyaNgaM vApi yaSasvinam ..”)
vyaNgyaH, tri, vyaYjanayA boDyo'rTaH . yaTA, -- “vAcyo'rTo'BiDayA boDyo lakzyo lakzaRayA mataH . vyaNgyo vyaYjanayA tAH syustisraH Sabdasya SaktayaH ..” iti sAhityadarpaRe 2 paricCedaH ..

vyajanam, klI, (vyajatyaneneti . vi + aja + lyuw . ‘vA yO .’ 2 . 4 . 57 . iti pakze vIBAvo nAsti .) tAlavfntakam . ityamaraH .. pAKA iti BAzA .. (yaTA, ftusaMhAre . 1 . 8 . “sacandanAmbuvyajanodBavAnilEH sahArayazwistanamaRqalArpaREH . savallakIkAkaligItanisvanEH prabuDyate supta ivAdya manmaTaH ..”) asya sAmAnyaguRaH . mUrcCAdAhatfzRAGarmma- SramanASitvam .. tAlavyajanaguRaH . tridozaSama- natvam . laGutvaYca . vaMSavyajanaguRaH . rUkza- tvam . uzRatvam . vAyupittakAritvaYca .. vetra- vastramayUrapucCavyajanaguRaH . tridozanASitvam ..  bAlavyajanaguRaH . tejaskaratvam . makzikAdi- nivArakatvaYca . iti rAjavallaBaH ..

vyaYjakaH, puM, (vyanaktIti . vi + anja + Rvul .) aBinayaH . ityamaraH .. dve hfdgatakroDAdi- BAvABivyaYjake . vyanaktIti vyaYjakaH . anja Da Yi gati mrakzaRe RakaH . Sabdo'pi vAcakastadvallakzako vyaYjakastaTA ..” prakASake, tri . yaTA, manuH . 2 . 68 . “utpattivyaYjakaH puRyaH karmmayogaM niboData ..”)

vyaYjanam, klI, (vyajyate mrakzyate annAdi saMyojyate- 'neneti . vi + aYja + lyuw .) annopakaraRam . tattu sUpaSAkAdi . iti rAjanirGaRwaH .. tatpa- ryyAyaH . temanam 2 nizWAnam 3 . ityamaraH .. temaH 4 . iti SabdaratnAvalI .. (yaTA, fgvede . 8 . 67 . 2 . “Ano Bara vyaYjanaM gAmaSvamaByaYjanam ..”) asya guRAH . “vyaYjanaM SAkamatsyAKyaM hfdyaM vfzyaYca puzwidam . dravyeRa yena yeneha vyaYjanaM matsyamAMsayoH . tasya tasya tayoScEtadguRadozErviBAvayet ..” iti rAjavallaBaH .. vyaYjanaviSezaguRAH tattacCabde drazwavyAH .. * cihram . (vyaYjanA . yaTA, sAhityadarpaRe . 3 . 59 . “avAcyatvAdikaM tasya vakzye vaYjanarUpaRe ..”) SmaSru . (yaTA, mahABArate . 1 . 158 . 34 . “kuta eva parityaktuM sutaM SakzyAmyahaM svayam . bAlamaprAptavayasamajAtavyaYjanAkftim ..”) avayavaH . dinam . iti medinI .. strIpuMsayo- raSudDadaSaH . sa tu upasTaH . ardDamAtrakam . sa tu kakArAdikzakArAntavarRaH . iti DaraRiH (yaTA, sAhityadarpaRe . 10 . 640 . “satyarTe pfTagarTAyAH svaravyaYjanasaMhateH . krameRa tenEvAvfttiryamakaM vinigadyate ..”)

vyaYjanA, strI, (vi + aYja + Ric + yuc . wAp .) Sabdasya vfttiviSezaH . tasyA lakzaRaM yaTA, -- “viratAsvaBiDAdyAsu yayArTo boDyate'paraH . sA vfttirvyaYjanA nAma SabdasyArTAdikasya ca ..” SabdabudDikarmmaRAM viramya vyApArABAva iti nayenABiDA lakzaRA tAtparyyAKyAsu tisfzu vfttizu svaM svamarTaM boDayitvA upakzIRAsu yayAnyo'rTo boDyate sA SabdasyArTasya prakfti- pratyayAdeSca vfttirvyaYjana-Dvanana-gamana-pratyAyanA- divyapadeSavizayA vyaYjanA nAma . tatra . “aBiDAlakzaRAmUlA Sabdasya vyaYjanA dbiDA ..” aBiDAmUlAmAha .  cezwayA kayAttit dyotyate . evaM vaktrAdInAM vyastasamastAnAM vESizwye bodDavyam .. * .. “trEDiDyAdiyamarTAnAM pratyekaM triviDA matA ..” arTAnAM vAcyalakzyavyaNgyatvena trirUpatayA sarvvA apyanantaroktA vyaYjanAstriviDAH . tatra vAcyA- rTasya vyaYjanA yaTA . kAlo maDurityAdi .. lakzyArTasya yaTA . niHSezacyutacandanamityAdi .. vyaNgyArTasya yaTA . ua Riccala ityAdi .. * .. prakftipratyayAdivyaYjanantu prapaYcayizyate . “SabdaboDyo vyanaktyarTaH Sabdo'pyarTAntarASrayaH . ekasya vyaYjakatve tadanyasya sahakAritA ..” yataH Sabdo vyaYjakatve'rTAntaramapekzyate . arTo- 'pi SabdaM tadekasya vyaYjakatve'nyasya sahakAri- tvamavaSyamaNgIkaraRIyam . “aBiDAditrayopADivESizwyAttriviDo mataH . Sabdo'pi vAcakastadvallakzako vyaYjakastaTA ..” aBiDopADiko vAcakaH . lakzaRopADiko lakzakaH . vyaYjanopADiko vyaYjakaH . kiYca . “tAtparyyAKyAM vfttimAhuH padArTAnvayaboDane . tAtparyyArTaM tadarTaYca vAkyaM tadboDakaM pare ..” aBiDAyA ekEkapadArTaboDanaviramAt vAkyArTa- rUpasya padAnvayasya boDikA tAtparyyA nAma vfttistadarTaSca tAtparyyArTastadboDakaYca vAkyamitya- BihitAnvayavAdinAM matam . iti sAhityadarpaRe vAkyasvarUpanirUpaRo nAma dvitIyaH pari- cCedaH ..
vyaqambakaH, puM, eraRqaH . ityamaraH ..

vyatikaraH, puM, (vi + ati + kf + ap .) vyasanam . (yaTA, kaTAsaritsAgare . 74 . 89 . “asmin vyatikare vftte SatrutAmeva te gataH ..”) vyatizaNgaH . iti medinI .. SElA ivonnatAH santu kintu prakftikomalAH ..” iti candrAlokaH ..

vyatizaNgaH, puM, (vi + ati + zaYja + GaY .) para- sparamelanam . (yaTA, mahABArate . 12 . 103 . 5 . “senayorvyatizaNgeRa jayaH sADAraRo'Bavat ..” vinimayaH . yaTA, BAgavate . 5 . 13 . 13 . “anyonyavittavyatizaNgavfdDa- vErAnubanDo viharan miTaSca ..”)

vyatihAraH, puM, (vi + ati + hf + GaY .) vini- mayaH . yaTA, -- “paridAnaM vinimayo nEmeyaH parivarttanam . vyatihAraH parAvartto vEmeyo vimayo'pi ca ..” iti hemacandraH .. (yaTA, raGuH . 12 . 92 . “vikrama-vyatihAreRa sAmAnyABUddbayorapi . jayaSrIrantarAvedirmattavAraRayoriva ..”)
vyatItaH, tri, (vi + ati + i + ktaH .) atItaH . gataH . yaTA, -- “ardDarAtre vyatIte tu saMkrAntiryadaharBavet . pUrbbe vratAdikaM kuryyuH paredyuH snAnadAnayoH .. iti tiTitattve BImaparAkramIyam ..

vyatIpAtaH, puM, (vi + ati + pata + GaY . “upa- sargasya GaYIti .” 6 . 3 . 122 . iti upa- sargasya dIrGaH .) mahotpAtaH . apayAnam . iti medinI .. vizkamBAdisaptaviMSatiyogAnta- rgatasaptadaSayogaH . tatra sarvvakarmmavarjanaM yaTA, -- “niraMSaM divasaM vizwiM vyatIpAtaYca vEDftim . kendraM vApi SuBErhInaM pApAhamapi varjayet .. pariGasya tyajedardDaM SuBakarmma tataH param . gaRqavyAGAtayoH zaw ca nava harzaRavajrayoH . vEDftivyatipAtO ca samastO parivarjayet ..” * .. asya pratiprasavamAha BImaparAkrame . “na vizkamBo navA gaRqo na vyatIpAtavaDftI . candratArAbale prApte dozA gacCantyasaMmuKAH .. navamyaNgArako vizwiH SanEScaradinaM taTA . vyatIpAto na dUzyecca yasyArko dakziRe sTitaH .. yadi vizwivyatIpAtO dinaM vApyaSuBaM Bavet . hanyate'mftayogena BAskareRa tamo yaTA ..” iti jyotistattvam .. * .. tatra jAtaPalam . “kaWoravAkyaH piSunasvaBAvo gadAturo mAtfhito manuzyaH . parasya kAryye kftapakzapAto yasya prasUtO vyatipAtayogaH ..” iti kozWIpradIpaH .. pAriBAzikayogaviSezaH . yaTA, bfhanmanuH . “SravaRASviDanizWArdrAnAgadEvatamastake . yadyamA ravivAreRa vyatIpAtaH sa ucyate ..” tatra gaNgAsnAnaPalaM yaTA . brahmARqe .  “saMkrAntizu vyatIpAte grahaRe candrasUryyayoH . puzye snAtvA tu jAhravyAM kulakowIH samudDaret ..” iti prAyaScittatattvam .. (yaTA ca BAgavate . 4 . 12 . 48 . “dinakzaye vyatIpAte saMkrame'rkadine'pi vA . SrAvayet SraddaDAnAnAM tIrTapAdapriyASrayaH ..”)

vyatIhAraH, puM, (vi + ati + hf + GaY . “upa- sargasya GaYIti .” 6 . 3 . 122 . iti dIrGaH .) parIvarttaH . iti jawADaraH .. paraspara- mekajAtIyakriyAkaraRam . yaTA, keSAkeSi . daRqAdaRqi . ityAdi . iti vyAkaraRam ..

vyatyayaH, puM, (vyatyayanamiti . vi + ati + i + “erac .” 3 . 3 . 56 . ityac .) vyatikramaH . tat- paryyAyaH . vyatyAsaH 2 viparyyAsaH 3 viparyyayaH 4 . ityamaraH .. (yaTA, BAgavate . 7 . 10 . 44 . “parAvarezAM sTAnAnAM kAlena vyatyayo mahAn ..”)

vyatyAsaH, puM, (vyatyasanamiti . vi + ati + as + GaY .) viparyyayaH . ityamaraH .. (yaTA, harivaMSe . 27 . 29 . “mAtrAsi vaYcitA Badre ! caruvyatyAsahetunA . Bavizyati hi puttraste krUrakarmmAtidAruRaH ..”)

vyaTa, za ma Na duHKe . cAle . Baye . iti kavi- kalpadrumaH .. (BvA0-Atma0-aka0-sew .) duHKaM duHKAnuBavaH . cAlaH kampanam . za, vyaTA . ma, vyaTayati . yaTitraH, tri, (vyaTa + ktaH .) pIqitaH . (yaTA, ftusraMhAre . 6 . 19 . “kAntAnanadyutimuzAmacirodgatAnAM SoBAM parAM kuruvakadrumamaYjarIRAm . dfzwvA priye hi paTikasya Bavenna kasya kandarpavARanikarErvyaTitaM hi cetaH ..”) duHKitaH . yaTA, -- “tataH pravyaTito bARo duhituH SrutadUzaRaH . tvaritaH kanyakAgAraM prApto'drAkzIt yadUdbaham ..” iti SrIBAgavate bARayudDe 62 aDyAyaH ..

(yaTA, mahABArate . 2 . 70 . 23 . “tUrRaM pratyAyanasvEtAn kAmaM vyaDvagatAnapi ..”)
vyapa, ka kzaye . iti kavikalpadrumaH .. (curA0- para0-aka0-sew .) antaH sTAdyayuktaH .. ka, vyApayati . iti durgAdAsaH ..

(yaTA, sAhityadarpaRe . 3 . 155 . “kapi kuntalasaMvyAnasaMyamavyapadeSataH . bAhumUlaM stanO nABipaNkajaM darSayet sPuwam ..”) nAma . iti trikARqaSezaH .. vAkyaviSezaH . yaTA, -- “vyAjenAtmABilAzoktirvyapadeSa itIryyate ..” ityujjvalanIlamaRiH ..

zawkarmma, [n] klI, (zawprakAraM karmma .) zaw- prakAraSAntyAdikarmma . yaTA, SAradAyAm . “aTABiDAsye tantre'smin samyak zawkarmma- lakzaRam . sarvvatantrAnusAreRa prayogaH PalasidDidaH .. ISacandrendranirftivAyvagnInAndiSo matAH . sUryyodayaM samAraBya GawikAdaSakaM kramAt .. ftavaH syurvvasantAdyAH ahorAtraM dine dine . vasantagrIzmavarzAKyaSaradDemantaSESirAH ..” yadvA, -- “ardDarAtraM SaratkAlo hemantaSca praBAtakaH . pUrvvAhRaSca vasantaH syAt maDyAhno grIzma eva ca .. prAvfqarUpo'parAhRaH syAt pradozaH SiSiraH smftaH ..” aTavA, -- “Uzoyoge ca hemantaH praBAte SiSirAgamaH . praharArdDe vasantaH syAt grIzmo maDyandinAgame . turyyayAme ca varzAKyaH SaradastaM gate ravO ..” * .. aTa kAlaniyamaH . “hemantaH SAntike prokto vasanto vaSyakarmmaRi . SiSiraM stamBane prokto vidveze grIzma eva ca . prAvfquccAwane jYeyA SaranmAraRakarmmaRi ..” * .. aTa tiTiniyamaH . “graYcamo ca dvitIyA ca tftIyA saptamI taTA . buDejyabArasaMyuktA vijYeyA dvezakarmmaRi .. kfzRA caturddaSI tadvadazwamI mandavArakAH . uccAwane tiTiH SastA pradoze ca viSezataH ..  pAyaM pAyaM prakurvvaMScet SlezmadozaM nivArayet .. na jAyate vArdDakaYca jvarI nEva prajAyate ..” iti GeraRqasaMhitAyAM zawkarmmaSoDanaM praTamo- 'DyAyaH ..

zawkarmmA, [n] puM, (zaw kammARi yajanAdIni yasya . yAgAdiBiryuto brAhmaRaH . ityamaraH . taTA ca . “ijyADyayanadAnAni yAjanADyApane taTA . pratigrahaSca tEryuktaH zawkarmmA vipra ucyate ..” zaw karmmARyasya iti bahubrIhiH . iti BarataH .

DyAnamasyAH pravakzyAmi sarvvaBUtanikfntanam .. bAlasUryyapraBAM devIM javAkusumasanniBAm . muRqamAlAvalIramyAM bAlasUryyasamAMSukAm .. suvarRakalasAkArapInonnatapayoDarAm . pASANkuSO pustakaYca taTA ca japamAlikAm ..” daDatImiti SezaH . “dvirAvfttyA zaqaNgAni viDAya parameSvari . yantramasyA varArohe trikoRaM tatpuwaM liKet .. vahirazwadalaM padmaM ravipatraM tato liKet . caturasraM caturddvAramevaM maRqalamAliKet .. zaqaNgAvaraRaM devi ! pUjayet pUrvvavacCive . ratyAdi tritayaM devi trikoRe paripUjayet .. qAkinyAdyASca zawkoRe vasupatre tataH param . brAhmyAdi yugalaM paScAdravipatre tataH param .. bAlAyAH pIWaSaktIstu vAmAdyAH pUjayet kramAt . caturasre lokapAlAn sAyuDAn parameSvari . anenEva viDAnena nityAKyAM BeravIM yajet ..” iti tantrasAraH ..

SAmBavIvaracakrAKyaM candrabinduviBUzitam . zazWamAjYAlayaM cakraM dvidalaM Svetamuttamam .. rADAcakraMmiti KyAtaM manaHsTAnaM prakIrttitam . sahasradalamekArRaM paramAtmaprakASakam .. nityajYAnamayaM satyaM sahasrAdityasanniBam . zaw cakrARIha BedyAni nEtadBedyaM kaTaYcana ..” iti pAdme svargaKaRqe 27 aDyAyaH .. * .. anyacca . “tattvasvarUpamekaM tat zawcakraM pratilakzayet . zawcakre'pi mahAmAyAM kzaRaM DyAtvA prayatnataH .. lambayenmUlamantreRa AdizoqaSacakrakam . AdizoqaSacakrasTAM sADakAnandakAriRIm .. cintayan sADako devIM japakarmma saBAraBet . Bruvorupari nAqInAM trayARAM prAnta ucyate . tatprAntaM tripaTasTAnaM zawkoRaM caturaNgulam .. raktavarRantu yogajYErAjYAcakramitIritam .. kaRWe trayARAM nAqInAM vezwanaM vidyate nfRAm . suzumneqApiNgalAnAM zawkoRaM tat zaqaNgrulam .. tat zawcakramiti proktaM SuklaM kaRWasya maDya- gam . trayARAmaTa nAqInAM hfdaye cEkatA Bavet .. tatsTAnaM zoqaSAsraM syAt saptANgulapramARataH . tat pItamuktaM yogajYErAdizoqaSacakrakam .. DyAnAnAmaTa mantrARAM cintanasya japasya ca . yasmAdAdyaYca hfdayaM tasmAdAdIti gadyate ..” iti kAlikApurARe 54 aDyAyaH .. * .. aparaYca . “mUlADAre trikoRAKye icCAjYAnakriyAtmake maDye svayamBuliNgantu kowisUryyasamapraBam .. tadUrdDe kAmabIjantu ka-la-SAntIndUnAdakam . tadUrdDe tu SiKAkArA kuRqalI brahmavigrahA .. tadDAhye hemavarRABaM va-sa-varRacaturddalam . drutahemasamapraKyaM padmaM tatra viBAvayet .. tadUrdDe'gnisamapraKya zaqdalaM hIrakapraBam . vAdilAntazaqarRena yuktADizWAnasaMjYakam ..  mUlamADArazawkAnAM mUlADAraM tato viduH ! svaSabdena paraM liNgaM svADizWAnaM tato viduH .. tadUrdDve nABideSe tu maRipUraM mahatpraBam . meGABaM vidyudABaYca bahutejomayaM tataH . maRivadBinnaM tat padmaM maRipUraM taTocyate .. daSaBiSca dalEryuktaM qAdiPAntAkzarAnvitam . SivenADizWitaM padmaM viSvalokEkakAraRam .. tadUrdDve'nAhataM padmamudyadAdityasanniBam . kAdiWAntAkzarErarkapatrESca samaDizWitam .. tanmaDye vARaliNgantu sUryyAyutasamapraBam . SabdabrahmamayaM Sabdo'nAhatastatra dfSyate .. tenAhatAKyaM padmaM tat muniBiH parikIrttyate . AnandasadanaM takzu puruzADizWitaM param .. tadUrdDvantu viSudDAKyaM dalazoqaSapaNkajam . svarEH zoqaSakEryuktaM DUmravarRaM mahatpraBam .. viSudDiM tanute yasmAt jIvasya haMsalokanAt . viSudDaM padmamAKyAtaM AkASAKyaM mahat param AjYAcakraM tadUrdDve tu AtmanADizWitaM param . AjYAsaMkramaRaM tatra gurorAjYeti kIrttitam .. kElAsAKyaM tadUrdDe tu boDanIntu tadUrdDataH . evaYca SivacakrARi proktAni tava suvrata .. sahasrArAmbujaM bindusTAnaM tadUrdDvamIritam . ityetat kaTitaM sarvaM yogamArgamanuttamam ..” iti tantrasAraH ..

zawcaraRaH, puM, (zaw caraRA yasya .) BramaraH . iti halAyuDaH .. (yaTA, AryyAsaptaSatyAm . 587 . “zawcaraRakIwajuzwaM parAgaGuRapUrRamAyuDaM tyaktvA . tvAM muzwimeyamaDyAmaDunA SaktiM smaro vahati ..”) yUkA . iti rAjanirGaRwaH .. zawpAdaSca ..

zaqAmnAyAH, puM, (zaw AmnAyAH .) hiraRyakaSipuH, puM, dEtyaviSezaH . sa tu kaSyapasya dityAM patnyAM jAtaH . tasya sahodaraH hira- RyAkzaH . tasya BAryyA kayADuH . tasya puttrAH saMhrAdaH 1 anuhrAdaH 2 hrAdaH 3 prahrAdaH 4 . kanyA siMhikA . iti SrIBAgavatam .. api ca . “tvayA yO nihatO deva ! dAnavO maDukEwaBO . avatIrRO punardEtyO BUtvA kaSyapanandanI . hiraRyakaSipuScEva hiraRyAkzo mahAsuraH ..  sudurjayodDatO tO tu punarjAtO mahAbalO . pulastyasya kule deva ! rAkzasendrAvarO ca tO .. tayolu pAdavinyAsamasahantI janArdana ! . tavAntikamanuprAptA daSAsyakumBakarRayoH ..” iti vahnipurARe vESravaRavarapradAnanAmADyAyaH .. tadutpattyAdi yaTA, -- “dityAH puttradvaTaM jajYe kaSyapAditi naH Srutam . hiraRyAkzaSca durdDarzo hiraRyakaSipustaTA .. kaSyapasyASramo'pyAsIt puRye vE puzkare purA . fziBirdevatABiSca ganDarvvErupaSoBitaH .. AsanAnyupakxptAni kAYcanAni tu paYca vE . fzIRAmftvijAM te vE upavizwA yaTAkramAt .. hotustatrAsanaM yattu havistatrATa juhvataH . antarvvatnI ditiScEva patnI ca samupAgatA .. daSavarzasahasrARi garBastasyAmavarttata . sa tu garBo viniHsftya mAturvE udarAttadA .. nizasAdAsane garBaH kaSyapasyApi sanniDO . taM dfzwvA munayastasya nAmAkurvvanta tadDitam . hiraRyakaSipustasmAt karmmaRAnena sa smftaH . hiraRyAkzo'nujastasya siMhikA ca taTAnujA . rAhoH sA jananI devI vipacitteH parigrahaH . hiraRyakaSipurdEtyaScakAra paramaM tapaH . tato varzasahasrARi nirAhAro hyaDaHSirAH .. taM brahmA CandayAmAsa dEtyaM tuzwo vareRa tu . sarvvAmaratvaM vavre sa SastrAstrErna divA niSi .. ahaM sarvvaM vinirjitya sarvvadevatvamAsTitaH . aRimAdiguRESvaryyameza me dIyatAM varaH .. tenEvamukto brahmA tu tasmE dattvA yaTepsitam . dattvA cAsya saBAM divyAM tatrEvAntaraDIyata .. hiraRyakaSipurdEtyaH SlokErgOtaH purAtanaH .. rAjA hiraRyakaSipurdEtyo yAM yAM nizevate . tasyAM tasyAM namaScakrurdevatA fziBiH saha .. evaM praBAvo dEtyo'BUt hiraRyakaSipuH purA .. svayamagniSca sUryyaSca vAyurindro jalaM svayam . BUtvA cakAra rAjyaM sa manvantaracaturdaSa .. tasyAsIt narasiMhastu gftyurvizRuH purA kila . naKEstena vinirBinno nArdraSuzkA naKAH smftAH .. hiraRyAkzasutAH paYca vikrAntAH sumahAbalAH . hiraRyakaSipoH puttrAScatvAraH sumahAbalAH .. prahrAdaH pUrbbajastezAmanuhrAdastaTEva ca . saMhrAdaScEva hrAdaSca hrAdaputtrAn SfRuzva tAn ..” iti vahnipurARe kaSyapIyaprajAmarganAmADyAyaH ..

hiraRyakAmaDenuH, strI, (hiraRyanirmmitA kAma- Denuryatra .) zAqaSamahAdAnAntargatamahAdAna- viSezaH . yaTA, -- matsya uvAca . “aTAtaH saMpravakzyAmi kAmaDenuviDiM param . sarvvakAmapradaM nFRAM mahApAtakanASanam ..  lokeSAvAhanaM tadvadDomakAryyADivAsanam . tulApuruzavat kAryyaM kuRqamaRqapavedikam .. svalpezvekAgnivat kuryyAdgururekaH samAhitAH . kAYcanasyAtiSudDasya DenuM vatsaYca kArayet .. uttamA palasAhasrA tadardDena tu maDyamA . kanoyaso tadardDena kAmaDenuH prakIrttitA . DAmnAmaDISAya BavABavAya pApOGadAvAnala dehi SAntim .. vasvazwakAdityamarudgaRAnAM tvameva DAtA paramaM viDAnam . yatastato me hfdayaM prayAtu DarmmEkanAma tvamaGOGanASAt .. iti turagaraTapradAnametat BavaBayasUdanamatra yaH karoti . sa kaluzapawalErvvimuktadehaH paramamupEti padaM pinAkapAReH .. dedIpyamAnavapuzA vijitapraBAva- mAkramya maRqalamaKaRqalacaRqaBAnoH . sidDANganAnayanazawpadapIyamAna- vaktrAmbujo'mbujaBavena ciraM sahAste .. iti paWati SfRoti vA ya itTaM kanakaraTaturagapradAnamasmin . na sa narakapuraM vrajet kadAcit narakariporBavanaM prayAti BUpa ! ..” iti mAtsye hiraRyASvaraTapradAtiko nAma 255 aDyAyaH ..
